general.subsanacion_ayuda: Include only the administrative information needed, without unnecessary personal data.
general.subsanacion_confirmacion: The correction will be recorded and the case will continue through the objections process. This does not approve the audit review.
general.subsanacion_preparacion_ayuda: Download the recovery file before submitting. The download starts in this browser; check that you can retain the file.
general.subsanacion_preparada: The operation is prepared and has not yet been submitted.
general.subsanacion_preparacion_error: The original request could not be retained. No request has been submitted; prepare the operation again.
general.subsanacion_archivo_advertencia: The file contains the correction notes. Keep it safe and do not share it; downloading does not confirm that it was saved.
general.subsanacion_descarga_iniciada: Download started. Check that you have retained the file before submitting.
general.subsanacion_descarga_error: The download could not be started. No request has been submitted.
general.subsanacion_importacion_titulo: Advanced option: resume an interrupted correction
general.subsanacion_importacion_lista: Load the original file for this case to view or recover that operation.
general.subsanacion_importacion_ayuda: Select the original file for this case. Importing it does not submit anything; you can then retry the same operation manually.
general.subsanacion_archivo: File you downloaded when preparing the correction
general.subsanacion_archivo_invalido: Invalid file, file for another case, or an existing pending request. No request has been submitted.
general.subsanacion_archivo_importado: Original request recovered. No request has yet been submitted in this session.
general.subsanacion_enviando: Submitting one request. Wait for confirmation.
general.subsanacion_actualizacion_pendiente: The correction has been confirmed and retains its receipt. The details and history have yet to update; check the case again.
general.subsanacion_indeterminada: The outcome could not be verified. The original operation remains locked until its receipt is recovered; do not submit another correction.
general.subsanacion_recuperacion_ayuda: Resubmit only the content and key of the original operation. If it was already recorded, the server will return its receipt without creating another correction.
general.subsanacion_recuperacion_confirmacion: The original operation will be resubmitted with the same key. No new notes will be created or edited.
general.subsanacion_recuperando: Checking the original operation with the same key. Wait for the server receipt.
general.subsanacion_recuperacion_no_confirmada: The server rejected this retry, but the outcome of the original operation remains unverified. Check the case before proceeding.
general.subsanacion_montaje_error: The correction form could not be loaded. Reopen the case.
general.subsanacion_error: The correction could not be confirmed. The outcome may require an authorised check.
general.subsanacion_sin_permiso: Your profile does not permit you to record this correction. Contact the person responsible for the unit.
general.subsanacion_conflicto: The case or operation has changed. Check the case again before proceeding.
general.subsanacion_rechazada: The correction was rejected by the server.
